We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_broken includes "aliphatic carboxylic acid"? The description says breaking aliphatic carboxylic acid. Also bonds formed: C-N, bonds broken: C-O. So we can search.

First, get available functional groups to know naming.
